text: Better approach: Evaluate model on fresh test data which was not used during training. Test/train split: > Given data set (X,y), split into two sets (Xtrain, Ytrain) and (Xtest, Yeest) » Train g models £, ..., f@ by finding parameters which minimize the loss on (Xtrain: Ytrain)- > Evaluate loss of each trained model on (Xtest, Ytest) Sometimes you will see the term validation set instead of test set. Sometimes there will be both: use validation set for choosing the model, and test set for getting a final performance measure.
